country.name: United Kingdom
country.regulator: Paid prize draws are usually not regulated by the Gambling Commission (they rely on a free entry route or a skill question), so set a budget.
country.eligibility: UK residents (some promotions exclude Northern Ireland, the Channel Islands or the Isle of Man; check the terms).
tips: Check the promoter is named and has Terms & Conditions, a UK address or company number, and a free postal entry route if tickets are sold.
Real promoters never ask winners to pay a fee, give bank log-ins or buy something to claim a prize.
Be wary of 'you've won' messages for competitions you don't remember entering.
report: Advertising Standards Authority: report a promotion
country.paid_note: Paid prize draws are usually not regulated by the Gambling Commission
